final: SELECT s.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.riskeval IS NOT NULL AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval
